name: What are the common types of garage conversions?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of garage conversions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage conversions typically involve transforming the space into an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), a home office, a gym, or an additional living area like a family room or bedroom. ADUs are popular for rental income or multi-generational living, while other conversions offer expanded personal living space without moving. Each type requires specific considerations regarding plumbing, electrical, insulation, and entry points, impacting design and permitting requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), home offices, gyms, and additional living spaces like family rooms or bedrooms.
